game_concept: A adventure race set in Frost Peaks – Rope Line, a long fixed rope line: the avalanche scout must handle storm winds while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Checkpoint: Check key membership with in before reading dictionary values.
theme: Frost Peaks – Rope Line: a long fixed rope line
core_gameplay_loop: In Rope Line, repeat each round: Check key membership with in before reading dictionary values. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the avalanche scout ahead. Then check the checkpoint value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the rope bridge by solving code steps involving checkpoint that move the avalanche scout forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the rope bridge first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 3 (intro tier): Key Checkpoint
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Checkpoint' (Week 8 slot 11), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Rope Line'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how checkpoint changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm winds in Rope Line.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
